counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with heading-bounded functional segments. Start markers are excluded and end markers are exclusive. ASCII lexical words are counted after line-break hyphen repair; sentences use terminal punctuation; paragraphs use extracted blank-line blocks. PDF page 2 is the contents page and is excluded from the 53-page technical denominator. Mechanical counts are reconciled against all rendered contact sheets before entering the schema-v3 record.
ambiguities: Page fractions use unique touched pages and are non-additive where functional chapters share physical pages.
Display equations, tables, plot labels, captions, parameter lists, source code, and data rows can inflate mechanical word, sentence, or paragraph counts.
Functional data-preprocessing, result, conclusion, and model-improvement segments are interleaved with the numbered model sections and therefore overlap by design.
The Further Work section is retained inside strengths-limitations because the existing chapter contract has no separate future-improvements chapter for this paper.
The appendix contains source data and executable R/MATLAB code; its language evidence concerns reproducibility labeling and artifact organization rather than prose style.
